title: Parking v1.4 transport schema, wire schema_version 2
description: Closed message shapes. Root validates MQTT body union; dispatch by topic using x-topic-definitions. Application semantic checks are listed separately.

clock_synced.description: boolean; equals envelope; true iff clock_status.state is SYNCED or HOLDOVER

clock_status.description: ClockStatus; clock_synced=true iff state is SYNCED or HOLDOVER

overdue.description: boolean; true after unresolved threshold; retained independently of HELD

issued_at.description: UTC; normally trusted server time, immediate STOP exception may carry best available server UTC; TTL exception determines freshness

captured_at.description: trusted UTC original frame capture time|null; never changed when bytes are reused

clock_synced.description: boolean; trust of original captured_at, not upload time

width.description: integer1..1280; max(width,height)<=1280; preserve aspect ratio, no upscaling

height.description: integer1..1280; max(width,height)<=1280; preserve aspect ratio, no upscaling

created_at.description: trusted UTC job creation time|null; persisted for reboot age reconstruction

source_image_id.description: id|null; nonnull only when EVENT_CLOSE reuses an accepted CLOSE_CONFIRM JPEG

received_at.description: UTC; first server receipt of image status or JPEG, immutable

expires_at.description: UTC|null; file retention deadline once received JPEG; null if no JPEG stored

result_data.description: CommandResultData with token removed; see authorized GET command result

captured_at.description: trusted UTC|null; null before capture or when capture clock untrusted

error_code.description: image_error_code|null; required nonnull for FAILED/EXPIRED, null otherwise

error_bound_ms.description: integer>=0|null; valid adapter estimate rounded up, not a measured accuracy guarantee

last_sync_at.description: UTC|null; most recent externally synchronized anchor, not latest health-poll time

sync_age_ms.description: integer>=0|null; monotonic elapsed age of same-boot external sync anchor

roi_polygon_m.description: array of >=3 [finite x,finite y]; simple polygon

exit_polygon_m.description: array of >=3 [finite x,finite y]; simple polygon

windows.description: array of {weekday:integer1..7,start_hhmm:HH:mm,end_hhmm:HH:mm or24:00}; overnight split into two windows

starts_at.description: UTC; immediate MUST exactly equal Command.issued_at; scheduled MUST be later than issued_at and scope ZONE. Classify by this equality, never unreliable receiver wall time.

expires_at.description: UTC|null; pause ending, independent command TTL

identity_confirmed.description: boolean; true only after operator verifies same vehicle for OBSERVATION_REVIEW

reason.description: string1..200; evidence required for identity confirmation

confirmation_token.description: Public REST/SSE keeps the field but always returns null.

starts_at.description: null=immediate; server sets MQTT starts_at=issued_at. UTC=future schedule, ZONE only; past/equal request is rejected, never silently made immediate.

overdue.description: boolean; true after unresolved threshold; retained independently of HELD

x-semantic-checks.rule: Envelope device_seq/boot_id/clock_synced must equal snapshot; event reference and SSE id must match corresponding data.
Command expires_at is issued_at+60000ms. Immediate STOP starts_at==issued_at; future STOP requires ZONE, starts_at>issued_at and pause expiry after start. REST null normalizes only on server.
Timers.unresolved_ms>first_guidance_ms; policy base/version progression, geometric simplicity/noncollinearity and profile availability require service checks.
x-semantic-checks.checked_by_fixture_script: timer comparison only; other checks require implementation

x-semantic-checks.rule: Token purpose/event/image/boot/policy/mode/time binding, one-time consumption and clock trust require stored state and monotonic time.
Dedup payload identity, device_seq order, terminal event protection, concurrent updates, retries and physical output require persistence/integration tests.

Parse strict JSON: reject duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity and non-UTF8; enforce serialized UTF8 metadata<=65536B, JPEG<=5242880B, HTTP total-body bound separately. Schema number does not validate JPEG bytes.
x-semantic-checks.checked_by_fixture_script: strict parser helper and metadata byte limit only

x-semantic-checks.rule: Image source reuse needs accepted CLOSE_CONFIRM, same bytes/hash/capture metadata, valid originating command and same event; image lifecycle retention depends on authoritative server state.
ClockStatus bounds are syntactic necessary conditions. Actual state depends on external adapter validity, same boot, monotonic age, probe failure and time-jump evidence.
x-semantic-checks.checked_by_fixture_script: six supplied documented boundaries via synthetic evidence; not a real clock adapter

x-semantic-checks.rule: HTTP authorization, CSRF, device-to-topic/path ownership, public null token vs live OPERATOR token and SSE filtering require request context.

UTC values remain null if originally untrusted; operating windows do not cross midnight and require start<end plus registered timezone; raw IDs are opaque while registered device/zone IDs must be topic/path-safe.
